definitions.explanation: imposing or collecting fees for a service
paying for items or features within a game or app

examples.japanese: ⟦{利用|りよう}→利用：01752_riyou⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応|おう}じて→応じる：02018_oujiru⟧{課金|かきん}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: You are charged based on usage time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{月額|げつがく}→月額：09739_getsugaku⟧{課金|かきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧だ。
{従量|じゅうりょう}{課金|かきん}⟦{制|せい}→〜制：30791_sei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まる→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: The fee is determined by usage-based billing.

examples.japanese: ⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{課金|かきん}しすぎた。
examples.english: I spent too much on in-app purchases in the game.

examples.japanese: {課金|かきん}⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{強|つよ}く→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦なれない→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: You can't get stronger without paying.

examples.japanese: ⟦{無課金|むかきん}→無課金：19851_mukakin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいる→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: I play without spending any money.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{課|か}→課：01548_ka⟧ (impose, assign) + {金|きん} (money) → impose money/charges
{課金|かきん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to charge, to bill; to make in-app purchases)

COMPOUNDS:
- {課金|かきん}⟦{制|せい}→〜制：30791_sei⟧ (fee-based system)
- {従量|じゅうりょう}{課金|かきん} (usage-based billing)
- ⟦{月額|げつがく}→月額：09739_getsugaku⟧{課金|かきん} (monthly billing)
- ⟦{無課金|むかきん}→無課金：19851_mukakin⟧ (free-to-play without paying)
- {廃課金|はいかきん} (excessive in-app spending - slang)
- ⟦{微課金|びかきん}→微課金：29819_bikakin⟧ (light spending - slang)

MODERN USAGE:
The word has gained a new colloquial meaning in gaming culture, referring specifically to in-app purchases in mobile/online games. "{課金|かきん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧" can mean "to pay real money in a game," often for gacha (loot box) systems or premium items.
